papa.label: Papa's book
papa.subject: Offline sync: the review's fixes. Appends to one tab take turns inside a process (a save and the outbox sending a kept one at once had picked the same row, the second over the first); a write counts once Google answers 2xx even if reading the answer fails; papa's reads run one after another (an older read had landed on a newer one); every uncertain failure says "It may have saved: check" and the page reads again (no answer from the app's own server, an unreadable answer, wrote: true); no Delete on a save that is sending; a kept bill/line that lands without its photo or second write says so; Stocks puts no-internet on Main/Holdings/Received reads on the line too. Test: two appends at once land on two rows in every app (mutant red); e2e and every suite as before.

mumma.label: Mumma
mumma.subject: Mumma: a point on the keypad where 00 was, so satang can be typed. Asked: "add a . or point as well claude design then implement it. replace the 00 button with it". Keypad 1-9, ".", 0, rub out; one point, at most two digits after it, "." first makes "0."; the big amount shows the point the moment it is pressed ("฿1,250."); amounts show two places only when there are satang (฿1,250.50, whole ones unchanged); totals are added in satang so they never drift; the sheet keeps two decimals (it rounded to whole baht). Both Mumma and Lydia. Unit tests + drive pass; 6 mutants red: 00 back, whole-baht display, sheet rounding, two points, whole-baht totals, point not shown while typing
